scripts.build: pnpm run build:api && pnpm run build:workspace-deps
scripts.build:workspace-deps: TSC_FLAGS='--ignoreConfig --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target es2024 --strict --exactOptionalPropertyTypes --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --verbatimModuleSyntax --isolatedModules --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop --resolveJsonModule --types node' && tsc ../../packages/domain/src/index.ts --outDir dist/node_modules/@ohmydate/domain --rootDir ../../packages/domain/src $TSC_FLAGS && tsc ../../packages/contracts/src/index.ts --outDir dist/node_modules/@ohmydate/contracts --rootDir ../../packages/contracts/src $TSC_FLAGS && tsc ../../packages/provider-vikunja/src/index.ts --outDir dist/node_modules/@ohmydate/provider-vikunja --rootDir ../../packages/provider-vikunja/src $TSC_FLAGS && tsc ../../packages/scheduler/src/index.ts --outDir dist/node_modules/@ohmydate/scheduler --rootDir ../../packages/scheduler/src $TSC_FLAGS && node --input-type=module -e "import{writeFileSync}from'node:fs';for(const p of ['domain','contracts','provider-vikunja','scheduler']){writeFileSync('dist/node_modules/@ohmydate/'+p+'/package.json',JSON.stringify({name:'@ohmydate/'+p,type:'module',exports:{'.':{default:'./index.js'}}},null,2))}"
